description: This file defines functions related to chart theming, including retrieving CSS variables and generating a theme object with color tokens for charts, supporting dark mode and CSS variable fallbacks.

methods.name: getCssVar
methods.description: Reads a CSS variable from :root, returning a fallback if unavailable or on error.

methods.name: withAlpha
methods.description: Converts a hex color to an rgba string with specified alpha, with fallback on failure.

methods.name: getChartTheme
methods.description: Generates a chart theme object with color tokens, sourcing from CSS variables or falling back to dark theme tokens.
